description: Defines the ShareAccountTransaction entity class for managing share account transactions, including creation, updates, status changes, and charge handling within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: ShareAccountTransaction
classes.description: Entity class representing transactions on share accounts, including purchase, redemption, and charge transactions, with methods for managing transaction states and amounts.

methods.name: setShareAccount
methods.description: Associates a ShareAccount with this transaction.

methods.name: ShareAccountTransaction
methods.description: Constructor initializing a purchase transaction with date, total shares, and share value.

methods.name: createRedeemTransaction
methods.description: Static factory method to create a redemption transaction.

methods.name: createChargeTransaction
methods.description: Static factory method to create a charge payment transaction.

methods.name: getPurchasedDate
methods.description: Returns the transaction date.

methods.name: getTotalShares
methods.description: Returns the total number of shares involved in the transaction.

methods.name: getPurchasePrice
methods.description: Returns the share value at purchase.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates transaction details including date, total shares, and share value.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Marks the transaction as approved.

methods.name: undoApprove
methods.description: Reverts the transaction approval to applied state.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the transaction and adjusts amount if charge exists.

methods.name: isPendingForApprovalTransaction
methods.description: Checks if transaction is pending approval.

methods.name: isPurchasTransaction
methods.description: Checks if transaction is a purchase.

methods.name: isRedeemTransaction
methods.description: Checks if transaction is a redemption.

methods.name: isChargeTransaction
methods.description: Checks if transaction is a charge payment.

methods.name: isPurchaseRejectedTransaction
methods.description: Checks if purchase transaction was rejected.

methods.name: addShareAccountChargePaidBy
methods.description: Adds a charge payment record to the transaction.

methods.name: amount
methods.description: Returns the total amount of the transaction.

methods.name: chargeAmount
methods.description: Returns the charge amount associated with the transaction.

methods.name: updateChargeAmount
methods.description: Updates the charge amount and total amount.

methods.name: deductChargesFromTotalAmount
methods.description: Subtracts charges from total amount.

methods.name: getChargesPaidBy
methods.description: Returns the set of charges paid by entities.

methods.name: getTransactionStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionType
methods.description: Returns the type of transaction.

methods.name: updateAmountPaid
methods.description: Sets the amount paid for the transaction.

methods.name: addAmountPaid
methods.description: Adds to the amount paid, adjusting for transaction type.

methods.name: resetAmountPaid
methods.description: Resets the amount paid to zero.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates the transaction.

methods.name: updateTransactionDate
methods.description: Updates the transaction date.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the transaction is active.

methods.name: shareValue
methods.description: Returns the share value for the transaction.
